description: An independent group tested five arrangements of attention and its internal control in two cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning tasks. Agents whose internal control acted on attention, the arrangement closest to AST, did somewhat better, with a marginal advantage.
limitations: Exploratory and preliminary results, transformer-style attention rather than biological attention, and a margin the authors call marginal.

sources.quote: these exploratory experiments suggest that equipping artificial agents with a model of attention can enhance their social intelligence
Our preliminary results suggest that Hypothesis 5 shows marginal advantages over other hypotheses.
